name: conjunto-app
description: Aplicacion web de gestion para conjunto habitacional (backend + frontend).
author: Nick Landeta

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.web:dev: concurrently -k "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
